VOD_SER_SC_1CK60HAG1IA.title: Emperatriz S01E125 Emperatriz S01E125

The series premiered on 5 April 2011, 19 days after filming the first scene, at 8:30pm, occupying Prófugas del Destino's slot, and ended on 8 November 2011. Emperatriz is also known as most selling telenovela of 2011.
